source.note: the old Supabase project is gone (NXDOMAIN); schema ported from the repo, no data import

vars.SUPABASE_URL: this environment's public URL; the API requires the token issuer <SUPABASE_URL>/auth/v1
vars.SUPABASE_JWT_SECRET: this environment's JWT secret (GET api-keys?reveal=jwt_secret, owner or admin with MFA); project auth signs HS256 with it

server_env.why: POST /api/v1/auth/device verifies the mobile access token (core/supabase_auth.verify_supabase_jwt) and re-links existing accounts by verified email (MN9)

apple.notes: Native signInWithIdToken: the iOS bundle id is the aud; no Services ID or .p8 secret needed.

google.notes: Google sign-in is OFF in the app until Menivor gets its OWN OAuth client (never reuse another product's client ids). Set ios_client_id + web_client_id and enabled=true when it exists.

smtp.why: Email one-time-code sign-in (the sign-in that works on Android and any device) sends a 6-digit code from no-reply@menivor.com. The magic-link/OTP email template must include {{ .Token }} so the mail carries the code the app asks for. The app shows email sign-in only when app.json expo.extra.auth.email is true (or EXPO_PUBLIC_EMAIL_SIGNIN=1).

todo: Menivor Google OAuth client (iOS + web client ids) does not exist yet; Google stays disabled
Verify menivor.com as a Scribase Mail sending domain and put {{ .Token }} in the magic-link email template, smoke-test a code, then set apps/mobile/app.json expo.extra.auth.email=true
notes: Sign-in: Apple (iOS) + email one-time code (all devices, behind expo.extra.auth.email) ; Google waits for Menivor's own OAuth client. No password UI.

Dedicated project: public schema (the menivor schema existed only to share the old cipher project). Account erasure: Menivor API POST /me/erase, then the app calls delete_own_account() to remove the sign-in identity. No edge functions.

Switch order: (1) scribase-move-apps.sh --only menivor; (2) set server_env on the API box and restart it (owner); (3) ship a build with the new EAS env. Runbook: videogen docs/runbooks/mobile-auth-scribase.md.
